title: Group chats get the same attachment folders as personal ones
summary: The documents / audio / voice-notes split shipped for one-to-one chats earlier today now works in group chats too. Along the way the group chat stopped keeping three separate copies of the same database query — the reason a filter added in one place had no effect in the other two.

changes.title: Documents, audio and voice notes listed separately in a group
changes.description: The group chat's ⋮ menu now narrows the conversation to documents, to audio files, or to voice notes, and back to everything — the same four entries as a personal chat. Voice notes stay out of the audio list so the two are separate places to look. Verified on a phone: with a photo, a voice note and an mp3 in one group, each filter shows exactly its own kind.

changes.title: One query instead of three copies
changes.description: Opening a group, refreshing it and searching in it each ran their own copy of the same query. They now share one, so a change to what a group list shows cannot silently apply to one path and not the others.
